newsitem.title: UK: PIA says ex-UK to Pakistan freighters going out full.
newsitem.headline: PIA says ex-UK to Pakistan freighters going out full.

text.p: Recently launched three times a week Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) Boeing 707 freighter flights from London to Karachi are generally going out full, PIA cargo marketing executive Nazim Rahimtoola said.
The service was launched on May 28.

The freighters, departing Heathrow on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays, offer 30 to 35 tonnes capacity and are carrying machinery, chemicals and general cargo for Dubai, Pakistan and Far East destinations, he told Reuters.
Inward flights, also via Dubai, are bringing in fruit and vegetables from Pakistan, he added.
PIA also operates six full passenger Boeing 747 flights a week from the UK to Pakistan each offering five pallet positions or 10 to 15 tonnes of cargo per flight.

Additionally on Sundays there is a 747 combi aircraft departing London with 13 pallet positions or 40 to 45 tonnes capacity, he said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
